> I want to design and build a compact FPV quadcopter from individual electronic and mechanical components. The drone will use four brushless motors, a flight controller, an ESC, an analog FPV camera and a wireless radio receiver. I will design or customize its frame, prepare the wiring diagram, select compatible components and document the complete assembly process. My goal is to learn about aerodynamics, motor control, electronics and FPV communication through a working drone.
